tokens.name: surface-ground
tokens.usage: Base of the dark product UI (the lower half of the window). White text sits on it at 19.7:1.

tokens.name: surface-row
tokens.usage: Raised list rows and cards on `surface-ground`. Text: `text-primary` and `text-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-chip
tokens.usage: Status badges and small chips on `surface-row` ("Viewed").

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: The one accent: selected row, invoice detail panel, active tab and nav pill, highlighted chart bar. Use as a large fill, not as text on `surface-ground` (4.4:1).

tokens.name: brand-blue-tint
tokens.usage: Frosted line-item tiles laid on `brand-blue`. Keep text on it at `on-brand` only for 18px+ amounts; small labels there are decoration, not required reading.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand-blue`. Measured pair is 4.49:1, just under 4.5:1 — kept exact from the source; use at 14px+ weight 500 or larger.

tokens.name: bar-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive chart bars on glass cards over photography.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, names and amounts on `surface-ground` and `surface-row`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-row` and `surface-ground` ("In 2 days", axis labels). About 7:1 on `surface-row`.

tokens.name: button-light
tokens.usage: Fill of the one light primary button ("Payout now") on `brand-blue`; its label is `surface-ground`.

tokens.name: backdrop-sky
tokens.usage: Pale sky-blue canvas behind the framed app window, never inside it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title ("Invoices") over the hero photo.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Headline figure on a glass card ("$ 142,560.00").

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Nav pills, badges, axis labels, due dates.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a badge or pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows and between tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space between panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Window margin around the page title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tiles, buttons inside a panel.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows, line-item tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The app window and the large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Nav and tab pills, badges, round buttons.

shadow.note: Buttons only. Each value is one box-shadow: 1px top highlight, 2px bottom shade, soft drop.

tokens.name: emboss-blue
tokens.usage: Primary button on `brand-blue` ("Payout now", the run button).

tokens.name: emboss-chip
tokens.usage: Secondary and icon buttons on `surface-chip` over `surface-ground` or `surface-row`.

tokens.name: emboss-light
tokens.usage: The selected `button-light` thumb of a segmented toggle sliding on a `brand-blue` track; no top highlight because the fill is already white.
